verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows Pipedream acting as an MCP server that external clients connect to, with 'Point any MCP client at Pipedream's remote server.' Nothing shows Pipedream itself connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools. Server-side MCP is a different role and earns no credit for this client-side story. Pipedream is an integration and agent platform, so this axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes the verdict none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
